identities.historicRegistration: Current native centerlines used as approximate 2011 location and route controls, not an exact historic reconstruction.

mapIdentity.scope: Whole Salang Tunnel in a coherent approximate 2011 appearance: complete named main bore and both intrinsic northern and southern avalanche galleries along all original mapped centerline controls; both tunnel ends, continuous road floor, lining/roof, concrete gallery roof/walls/open bays and structural supports, portal piers/beams and short retaining returns. Do not substitute one photographed portal for the full tunnel. Native current centerlines register the older structure approximately; precise historic gallery extents, profiles, grade, bay census and unseen southern portal details are estimated. Exclude the wider pass highway, unrelated culverts, natural mountain body, vehicles, soldiers, snow, signage and later 2013/2023 reconstruction finishes.

note: Original north-up frame and independent 8192 m field, 129 squared/16641 heights, six zoom12 raw tiles, datum3390.4595 m, frozen BEFORE all road floor grades and structural sections.
